whatHeldDataSupport: Provincial manufacturing revenue; no forest harvest quantity or area inferred

publicSources.scope: Canadian forested ecosystems, approximately 650 million hectares
publicSources.format: GeoTIFF within producer-linked ZIP; directory describes 978 MB
publicSources.licence: Open Government Licence - Canada; retain source and Hermosilla et al. 2016 citation
publicSources.meaning: Greatest detected stand-replacing harvest disturbance year over the period. Remote sensing; not all events, actual timber deliveries, legal cutblocks or current cutting permissions.
publicSources.metadataCaution: The Geo.ca record labels a ZIP as Harvest while pointing to a Fire ZIP. Use the producer harvest link recorded here; no fire raster was adopted.

publicSources.scope: Entire non-Arctic land mass of Canada
publicSources.licenceFromReadme: CC BY 4.0, source attribution required; research and commercial use allowed
publicSources.licenceHandling: Keep the version-specific readme and dataset/publication citation with any future derivative; both notices permit attributed reuse. Do not silently replace the readme notice with the older catalogue notice.
interpretationLimits: Tree removal may include road, mining or other infrastructure clearing; a harvested legal cutblock cannot be inferred.
Observation years may lag the event by one or two years; latest years have greater commission error.
Class 5 start year is the defoliation onset and ending year is harvest; do not count the start as harvest.
Latest rasters retain only the latest disturbance and cannot reconstruct every annual event.
Annual directory also lists an extra 1984 raster; the current documented coverage is 1985-2025.

publicSources.scope: BC Crown-land openings and silviculture submissions; existing reference is Prince George district DPG
publicSources.temporalCoverage: Historical and continually updated records; complete earliest/latest actual harvest years cannot be established without source attributes. The public example calculates stand age for 2020.
publicSources.licence: Open Government Licence - British Columbia, documented in the government example
publicSources.geometry: Multipolygon treatment units, NAD83 / BC Albers (EPSG:3005)
interpretationLimits: Opening boundaries can include natural disturbances and silviculture obligations. Filter completed harvest events and join verified dates; an opening alone is not a harvested area for a year.
Forest-cover REFERENCE_YEAR is an inventory reference year, not a verified harvest completion year.
Historical records can lack spatial boundaries; retain missing geometry rather than inventing polygons.
BC source cannot represent all Canadian provinces.
